verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows Atlassian publishing an official MCP *server* (jira-probe-3), which lets other AI agents call Jira's tools — the opposite of this story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Jira so Jira itself can consume their tools. No evidence shows Jira/Rovo acting as an MCP client capable of using externally supplied MCP tools.
